scenes.text: Congratulations. You've just been born in England, the year is 1347, and honestly? Your timing is terrible.
You're a peasant, which means you own nothing, you answer to a lord you've never met,
and you'll spend roughly two hundred days a year working his fields before you're allowed to touch your own.
Breakfast is bread. Lunch is bread. Dinner, if things are going well, is bread with a little pottage.
But don't worry about the long term. In about a year, a ship is going to dock in a small port called Melcombe... and it's carrying something that will change your life.
